high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Medium.com, dated 11:28 AM. The title of the article reads, "Analogous ways ANNs and biology might obtain the information needed to create neurons." The text discusses how companies building artificial neural networks (ANNs) do not need to have internal expertise on constructing devices that mimic formal neurons but can instead order these devices from other companies that specialize in such construction. Below the text, there is a microscopic image of neuroblast cells, labeled as a fluorescent micrograph. The image is credited to R. Bick and B.
